key_insight: F2LLM-v2 is a scalable family of multilingual embeddings (80M–14B) trained on 60M high-quality public samples that boosts representation quality for 200+ languages—with a focus on mid- and low-resource—by combining a two-stage LLM-driven training pipeline with matryoshka learning, pruning, and distillation.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between high-quality multilingual embedding performance and practical efficiency/scale, especially improving coverage and accuracy for underrepresented mid- and low-resource languages while offering deployable models across a wide range of sizes.
method: Curated a 60M-sample multilingual training composite covering 200+ languages, prioritizing mid- and low-resource data quality and diversity.

Two-stage LLM-based embedding training pipeline: LLM-guided supervision/alignment followed by scale-aware fine-tuning using matryoshka learning to transfer capabilities across 8 model sizes (80M–14B).
Model compression and efficiency: iterative pruning and knowledge distillation to produce performant, resource-friendly variants while preserving multilingual fidelity.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners ready-to-use, size-flexible multilingual embeddings that improve search/retrieval and downstream tasks for many languages—enabling better performance in production-constrained settings and for previously underserved languages.
visual_elements: Size vs. performance curve plotting the 8 model sizes (80M–14B) against key embedding metrics (e.g., retrieval accuracy, clustering quality).
Pipeline diagram showing the two-stage LLM-based training, matryoshka learning flow (large→smaller models), and pruning/distillation steps.
World map or heatmap indicating language coverage and emphasis on mid/low-resource regions.
Bar chart comparing F2LLM-v2 to baseline embeddings on representative multilingual retrieval/semantic-search benchmarks.
paper_title: F2LLM-v2: Inclusive, Performant, and Efficient Embeddings for a Multilingual World
paper_authors: Ziyin Zhang, Zihan Liao, Hang Yu, Peng Di, Rui Wang
